inputs.proposed_invalidation: Reject if AI infrastructure utilization, AWS growth or margins fail to compensate for capital intensity, financing costs and dilution, or if customer concentration and competition erode durable returns.
inputs.proposed_mechanism: AWS supplies compute, model services and infrastructure to AI workloads; durable utilization and pricing can expand Amazon's operating earnings, while the benefit to shareholders depends on returns exceeding depreciation, financing and dilution costs.

objective: Review Amazon's causal relationship to AI compute, networking and hyperscaler monetization.
